backends.description: List of upstream backend servers in 'host:port' format (HTTP or HTTPS)

max_concurrent_streams.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP/2 streams per upstream connection

connect_timeout.description: Timeout (in milliseconds) for establishing a connection to an upstream backend

idle_timeout.description: Idle timeout (in milliseconds) for upstream connections

tls.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for connections to upstream backends

tls_ca_cert.description: Path to CA certificate for validating upstream TLS; leave empty to use system store

tls_client_cert.description: Path to client certificate for mutual TLS authentication to upstream backends

tls_client_key.description: Path to private key for client certificate (used with mutual TLS)

mutual_tls.description: Enable mutual TLS (client certificate authentication) with upstream backends

tls_verify_hostname.description: Verify that upstream TLS certificate matches its hostname (SNI)

fallback.description: Fall back to HTTP/1.1 if HTTP/2 negotiation with upstream fails

retry_on_failure.description: Retry failed requests (only safe for idempotent methods like GET, HEAD, PUT, DELETE)

retry_count.description: Maximum number of retries per failed request

retry_on_status.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP status codes that trigger a retry

fronted.listen.description: IP address or hostname to bind the front-facing listener (e.g., '0.0.0.0'); leave empty to use '::' or '0.0.0.0' depending on family

fronted.port.description: Port number for the front-facing listener

fronted.server_cert.description: Path to server TLS certificate for the front-facing listener

fronted.server_private_key.description: Path to server private key for TLS

fronted.tls.description: Enable TLS on the front-facing listener (required for HTTP/2)

fronted.tls_min_version.description: Minimum TLS version to accept (e.g., '1.2' or '1.3')

fronted.ciphers.description: TLS cipher suites in OpenSSL format (colon-separated), ordered by preference

fronted.alpn.description: Enable ALPN negotiation to support HTTP/2 over TLS

fronted.client_max_concurrent_streams.description: Maximum number of concurrent HTTP/2 streams per client connection

fronted.request_header_buffer_size.description: Initial buffer size for incoming request headers (in bytes)

fronted.max_request_header_size.description: Maximum total size of request headers allowed (in bytes)

fronted.proxy_protocol.description: Enable HAProxy PROXY protocol on front-facing listener (for preserving client IP)

fronted.http1_upgrade.description: Allow HTTP/1.1 clients to upgrade to HTTP/2 via TLS ALPN or HTTP Upgrade

fronted.access_log_format.description: Optional custom access log format; leave empty to use combined format

fronted.error_log.description: Enable logging of errors and warnings

workers.description: Number of worker threads to spawn

daemon.description: Run nghttp2 as a background daemon process

daemon_pid_file.description: Path to PID file when running in daemon mode

daemon_user.description: User account to drop privileges to after binding to privileged ports

daemon_group.description: Group to drop privileges to after binding to privileged ports

strict_frame_size.description: Enforce strict RFC-compliant HTTP/2 frame size limits (default: 16 MiB)

server_push.description: Enable HTTP/2 server push (experimental and generally discouraged)

fronted.ocsp_stapling.description: Enable OCSP stapling for enhanced TLS certificate validation

fronted.ocsp_responder_cert.description: Path to certificate for OCSP responder (if using a non-system CA)

fronted.hpkp.description: Enable HTTP Public Key Pinning (HPKP) headers; strongly discouraged for new deployments

fronted.hsts.description: HSTS max-age in seconds (0 to disable)

fronted.hsts_preload.description: Add 'preload' directive to HSTS header (required for browser preload lists)
